ModMetadata.Name: ic10go testbench
ModMetadata.Author: ic10go
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]ic10go testbench[/h1] A local test server for IC10 development. It lets the ic10go toolchain (`ic10c testbench`) and the VSCode extension upload a compiled program to a chip, set device inputs, step the chip, and read back registers, stack and device values.
It listens on 127.0.0.1:7800 (NDJSON over TCP) and only acts when asked. Pair it with a test save that has IC hosts + a Logic Memory / LED; it can also auto-load that save at startup.
Configure the port, auto-load save and delay in Documents\My Games\Stationeers\ic10go\testbench.json.
